title.narrative: Feed the Future Nigeria Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services and Technology Promotion Activity

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY2022 funds, this activity will:.Strengthen sustainable agricultural extension and advisory services to reach at least two million smallholder farmers and other actors in agricultural value chains. Build the capacity of private extension service providers to deliver extension and advisory services capably and sustainably to smallholder farmers, and Strengthen linkages between agricultural research institutions and agriculture value chain stakeholders. Through technical assistance, training linked to inputs and outputs markets, and increasing access to finance, the activity will work with a variety of agricultural sector micro, small, and medium enterprises, importers, financial and insurance institutions, and government agencies to ensure that high quality agricultural inputs efficiently pass through the agro-input supply chain via private extension services providers and into the hands of farmers when they are needed. By stimulating inclusive, innovative, and pluralistic agricultural extension services, developing the capacity of agro-input suppliers and service providers, and facilitating the adoption of new technologies and improved production practices by smallholder farmers, the activity contributes to the Mission's Feed the Future strategy as well as Goal 1 and 2 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan. The activity will enable households to make informed production, marketing, and spending decisions--thereby making safe and nutritious foods more available, affordable, and accessible. The activity also promotes climate-smart agriculture, affordable, safe, and nutritious foods through technologies such as reducing contaminants in grains. The activity will link women and youth to digital financial services, offer training, internships, and enable women and youth to become entrepreneurs, employers or self-employed agro-dealers, or village promoters who develop solutions to address unequal access to land, inputs, finance, and extension services....
